name: USD/JPY Reaction to BOJ Rate Decisions
description: Analyzes how USD/JPY moves in the 5 trading days after BOJ rate decisions. Classifies events as surprise hikes (≥0.10% change) vs holds (0 change) using Japan call money rate (IRSTCI01JPM156N). Hold events are further split by VIX regime (VIX>=20 high vol vs VIX<20 low vol) to compare 5-day USD/JPY forward return distributions. VIX sourced from FRED VIXCLS daily series via economic_indicators for better date alignment. Shows 5-day forward return distributions via boxplot and mean bar chart, plus event markers for every BOJ decision. Also plots the full 20-day USD/JPY price path after each individual hike event, indexed to 100 at day 0, with VIX level at the time of each hike overlaid to reveal whether the vol regime explains divergence in USD/JPY reaction.
source:
# =============================================================================
# USD/JPY REACTION TO BOJ RATE DECISIONS
# =============================================================================
# Signal: Japan call money/interbank rate (IRSTCI01JPM156N) — monthly
# Regime: Hike (>=0.10%), Hold (0 change), Cut (<=-0.10%)
# Outcome: 5-day forward return on USD/JPY
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
usdjpy = common_fx_pairs(ticker=ReferenceFXPair.USDJPY)()
close = usdjpy.c

# VIX — FRED VIXCLS daily series (better date alignment than common_indices)
vix_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='VIXCLS')()
vix = ffill(vix_raw.result)

boj_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01JPM156N')()
boj_rate = ffill(boj_raw.result)

# =============================================================================
# BOJ REGIME CLASSIFICATION
# =============================================================================

# Detect new BOJ observations (monthly data points)
had_boj = is_valid(boj_raw.result)

# Prior rate (most recent past observation)
prior_rate = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(had_boj, boj_rate)
rate_change = boj_rate - prior_rate

# Regime flags — only fire on observation dates with a valid prior
is_hike = had_boj and is_valid(rate_change) and (rate_change >= 0.10)
is_hold = had_boj and is_valid(rate_change) and (rate_change > -0.10) and (rate_change < 0.10)
is_cut  = had_boj and is_valid(rate_change) and (rate_change <= -0.10)

# VIX regime split for hold events
is_high_vix = vix >= 20.0
is_low_vix  = vix < 20.0

# Hold sub-regimes
is_hold_high_vix = is_hold and is_high_vix
is_hold_low_vix  = is_hold and is_low_vix

# Regime label for boxplot grouping (string)
regime_label = 'Hike' if is_hike else ('Hold' if is_hold else ('Cut' if is_cut else 'N/A'))

# =============================================================================
# 5-DAY FORWARD RETURN ON USD/JPY
# =============================================================================
# forward_returns(period=5) = (close[t+5] - close[t]) / close[t]
# Positive = USD strengthens vs JPY (yen weakens)
# Negative = USD weakens vs JPY (yen strengthens)

fwd_5d = forward_returns(period=5)(close)

# Regime-filtered forward returns (sparse — only on BOJ decision dates)
hike_fwd5 = where(is_hike, fwd_5d)
hold_fwd5 = where(is_hold, fwd_5d)
cut_fwd5  = where(is_cut,  fwd_5d)

# Hold sub-regime forward returns
hold_high_vix_fwd5 = where(is_hold_high_vix, fwd_5d)
hold_low_vix_fwd5  = where(is_hold_low_vix,  fwd_5d)

# Rate change on event bars (for event markers)
hike_chg = where(is_hike, rate_change)
hold_chg = where(is_hold, rate_change)
cut_chg  = where(is_cut,  rate_change)

# Close price on event bars (for event markers)
hike_close = where(is_hike, close)
hold_close = where(is_hold, close)
cut_close  = where(is_cut,  close)

# =============================================================================
# 20-DAY PRICE PATH AFTER EACH HIKE (indexed to 100 at day 0)
# =============================================================================

# Days elapsed since the most recent hike (0 = hike day, 1 = day after, ...)
days_since_hike = barssince()(is_hike)

# Only look at the 20-day window following each hike
in_hike_window = is_valid(days_since_hike) and days_since_hike <= 20

# Hike event counter — increments by 1 on each hike, held forward via valuewhen
# Used as the split label so each hike gets its own line
hike_num_raw = cumulative()(1.0 if is_hike else 0.0)
hike_event_id = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(is_valid(hike_num_raw), hike_num_raw)

# Price at the most recent hike day (carried forward for normalization)
hike_anchor_price = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(is_hike, close)

# VIX level at the most recent hike day (carried forward for normalization window)
hike_anchor_vix = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(is_hike, vix)

# Normalize: 100 at day 0, then track the path
norm_path = (close / hike_anchor_price) * 100.0

# Filter to the 20-day window only (NaN outside)
path_in_window = where(in_hike_window, norm_path)
days_x = where(in_hike_window, days_since_hike)
event_label = where(in_hike_window, hike_event_id)

# VIX at hike anchor — flat within each event window (shows vol regime per hike)
vix_in_window = where(in_hike_window, hike_anchor_vix)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Table: Event counts + median 5d returns (FIRST — reference) ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='BOJ Decision Summary (5-Day USD/JPY Forward Return)',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['Event Count', 'Median 5d Return (%)'],
        col_headers=['Hike (>=0.10%)', 'Hold (All)', 'Hold VIX>=20', 'Hold VIX<20', 'Cut (<=-0.10%)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='BOJ Impact on USD/JPY',
    order=0
)(hike_fwd5, hold_fwd5, hold_high_vix_fwd5, hold_low_vix_fwd5, cut_fwd5)

# --- Chart 1: Boxplot — 5-day return distribution by regime (hold split by VIX) ---
# Variadic mode: one box per regime; hold split into high/low VIX sub-regimes
boxplot(
    title='Does VIX Regime Change the Hold Reaction? 5-Day USD/JPY Return Distribution',
    series_names=['Hike (>=0.10%)', 'Hold VIX>=20', 'Hold VIX<20', 'Cut (<=-0.10%)'],
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='5-Day USD/JPY Return (+ = USD up)',
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Orange, Color.Gray, Color.Red],
    median_color=Color.White,
    median_width=2,
    show_outliers=True,
    show_data_labels=True,
    data_label_format='{point.median:.3f}',
    category='BOJ Impact on USD/JPY',
    order=1
)(values=(hike_fwd5, hold_high_vix_fwd5, hold_low_vix_fwd5, cut_fwd5))

# --- Chart 2: Bar chart — mean 5-day return per regime (hold split by VIX) ---
xy_bars(
    title='Average USD/JPY Move in 5 Days After BOJ Decision',
    category='BOJ Impact on USD/JPY',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_label='Mean 5-Day Return',
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Hike (>=0.10%)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Hold VIX>=20',   color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Hold VIX<20',    color=Color.Gray),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Cut (<=-0.10%)', color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='No Move')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(hike_fwd5, hold_high_vix_fwd5, hold_low_vix_fwd5, cut_fwd5))

# =============================================================================
# 20-DAY AVERAGE PATH AFTER HOLD EVENTS (split by VIX regime)
# =============================================================================

# Days elapsed since the most recent hold event (0 = hold day, 1 = day after, ...)
days_since_hold = barssince()(is_hold)

# Only look at the 20-day window following each hold
in_hold_window = is_valid(days_since_hold) and days_since_hold <= 20

# Price at the most recent hold day (carried forward for normalization)
hold_anchor_price = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(is_hold, close)

# VIX regime at the most recent hold day (carried forward into the window)
hold_anchor_vix = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(is_hold, vix)

# Normalize: 100 at day 0, then track the path
hold_norm_path = (close / hold_anchor_price) * 100.0

# Days x-axis and normalized path — filtered to 20-day window
hold_days_x = where(in_hold_window, days_since_hold)
hold_path_in_window = where(in_hold_window, hold_norm_path)

# Split by VIX regime at the hold anchor
hold_anchor_high_vix = hold_anchor_vix >= 20.0
hold_anchor_low_vix  = hold_anchor_vix < 20.0

# High-VIX hold path (NaN outside high-VIX hold windows)
hold_path_high_vix = where(in_hold_window and hold_anchor_high_vix, hold_norm_path)
# Low-VIX hold path (NaN outside low-VIX hold windows)
hold_path_low_vix  = where(in_hold_window and hold_anchor_low_vix,  hold_norm_path)

# --- Chart 3: 20-day USD/JPY price path after each hike (split by event) ---
# VIX overlay: flat line per event at the VIX level on hike day — reveals vol regime
xy_lines(
    title='USD/JPY Path in 20 Days After Each BOJ Hike (Indexed to 100)',
    category='BOJ Impact on USD/JPY',
    split_by_label=True,
    x_axis_label='Days After BOJ Hike',
    y_axis_label='USD/JPY (Day 0 = 100)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    overlay_series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VIX at Hike', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=100.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Day 0 Level')
    ]),
    order=3
)(x_values=days_x, y_values=path_in_window, label=event_label, overlays=vix_in_window)

# --- Chart 4: Average 20-day USD/JPY path after BOJ holds, split by VIX regime ---
# x_category_type=Exact + agg=Mean averages all events at each day offset (0-20)
xy_bars(
    title='Does Carry Reassertion Persist? Avg USD/JPY Path After BOJ Holds by VIX Regime',
    category='BOJ Impact on USD/JPY',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=False,
    y_axis_label='Avg USD/JPY (Hold Day = 100)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Days After BOJ Hold',
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='High VIX (>=20)', color=Color.Orange, stack='High VIX'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Low VIX (<20)',   color=Color.Blue,   stack='Low VIX')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=100.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Hold Day Level')
    ]),
    order=4
)(values=(hold_path_high_vix, hold_path_low_vix), label=hold_days_x)

# --- Event Markers: Hike ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='BOJ Rate Hike',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero,          title='Rate Change (%)',    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle,      title='USD/JPY at Decision', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details,       title='5d Fwd Return',      type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details,       title='VIX at Hike',        type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    )
)(is_hike, hike_chg, hike_close, hike_fwd5, where(is_hike, vix))

# --- Event Markers: Hold ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='BOJ Rate Hold',
        icon=Icon.PauseIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero,          title='Rate Change (%)',    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle,      title='USD/JPY at Decision', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details,       title='5d Fwd Return',      type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_hold, hold_chg, hold_close, hold_fwd5)

# --- Event Markers: Cut ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='BOJ Rate Cut',
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero,          title='Rate Change (%)',    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle,      title='USD/JPY at Decision', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details,       title='5d Fwd Return',      type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_cut, cut_chg, cut_close, cut_fwd5)
